# Roushan Kumar - UX/UI and Product Designer

> Official portfolio of Roushan Kumar, a UX/UI and Product Designer based in Ahmedabad, India. Focus areas: SaaS, B2B, fintech, enterprise workflows, and mobile experiences.

Roushan works end-to-end, from understanding user problems through research and information architecture to interaction design, production-ready designs, and design systems.

## Primary sources

- [Full text portfolio and profile](https://roushan.in/portfolio.md): authoritative profile, contact details, and selected project descriptions.
- [Portfolio home page](https://roushan.in/): visual portfolio and project overview.
- [About section](https://roushan.in/#about)

## Selected projects

- [Roushani - mobile-first B2B invoicing SaaS](https://roushan.in/#case-study-roushani): Production MVP delivered in four weeks; product strategy, research, invoicing flows, customer and service reuse, branding, and PDF export.
- [Umbrella - enterprise third-party onboarding](https://roushan.in/#case-study-umbrella): NDA onboarding redesign informed by five usability sessions; clearer structure, validation, visual hierarchy, and user flow.
- [Design system, components, and icons](https://roushan.in/#case-study-design-system-icons): A dedicated project page for reusable components and icon work.
